left_out_note: Left out of the bindings record, counted with no list: 1 command not named in plain upper case (a key bound straight to a spell, macro, item or click may be one), and 0 keys not printable ASCII.
notes: A key reaches an action slot through the default UI's action buttons: button n of the bar showing page p is slot (p - 1) x 12 + n [verify]. The main bar is read at page 1 only, the page shown with no form, stance or stealth active; the pages shown by paging, a form, stance or stealth, or a possess, override or vehicle bar [verify], the pet and stance bars and an addon's buttons are not followed.

The bindings files are what the client last wrote; the record is what GetBindingKey returned at the lab-addon's last save. Neither is taken as the truth: each row names the sources that have that key on that command, and says where they disagree.
WowLab.lua is written at logout, /reload or a clean exit (a crash writes nothing): this is the character as of that save, not the session in progress.
